q: 雨还在下，他手里一直拿___一把伞。
zh: 雨还在下，他手里一直拿着一把伞。
py: yǔ hái zài xià tā shǒu lǐ yì zhí ná zhe yī bǎ sǎn
en: It is still raining, and he has been holding an umbrella the whole time.
why: 一直 describes a state that keeps holding, so 着 goes after 拿. 了 would report the moment he picked it up, and 过 would mean he had held one at some time before.

q: 天气热了，可是她还穿___毛衣。
zh: 天气热了，可是她还穿着毛衣。
py: tiān qì rè le kě shì tā hái chuān zhe máo yī
en: It has turned hot, but she is still wearing a sweater.
why: 还 points to a state that has not ended, so 穿着 says she still has it on. 了 would report putting it on, which clashes with 还, and 过 means she has worn one before.

q: 教室里的灯一直亮___，没有人关。
zh: 教室里的灯一直亮着，没有人关。
py: jiào shì lǐ de dēng yì zhí liàng zhe méi yǒu rén guān
en: The light in the classroom has been on all along, and nobody turned it off.
why: 一直 plus nobody turning it off describes a lasting state, so 亮着. 了 reports the light coming on, and 过 only an earlier experience.

q: 夏天的晚上，我们家的窗户总是开___，很凉快。
zh: 夏天的晚上，我们家的窗户总是开着，很凉快。
py: xià tiān de wǎn shàng wǒ men jiā de chuāng hù zǒng shì kāi zhe hěn liáng kuài
en: On summer nights our windows are always open, and it is cool.
why: 总是 describes how things usually stand, a held state, so 开着. 了 reports a single change and 过 an experience; neither fits a habitual scene.

q: 风一吹，门突然开___，我吓了一跳。
zh: 风一吹，门突然开了，我吓了一跳。
py: fēng yī chuī mén tū rán kāi le wǒ xià le yī tiào
en: The wind blew and the door suddenly opened. I jumped.
why: 突然 marks a change that has just happened, so 了. 着 describes a door that is already standing open and cannot go with a sudden event.

q: 他头上一直戴___一顶红帽子，怎么也不摘。
zh: 他头上一直戴着一顶红帽子，怎么也不摘。
py: tā tóu shàng yì zhí dài zhe yī dǐng hóng mào zi zěn me yě bù zhāi
en: He keeps a red hat on his head and never takes it off.
why: 一直 and 不摘 show the hat stays on, a held state, so 着. 了 would say he put it on once, and 过 would say he had worn it at some earlier time.

q: 朋友家的大门还关___，我们按了半天门铃也没人来开。
zh: 朋友家的大门还关着，我们按了半天门铃也没人来开。
py: péng yǒu jiā de dà mén hái guān zhe wǒ men àn le bàn tiān mén líng yě méi rén lái kāi
en: The gate of my friend's house was still shut; we rang the bell for ages and nobody came to open it.
why: 还 says the gate is still in the shut state, so 关着. 了 would report someone closing it, which does not fit 还, and 过 is experience.

s: 房间里的灯还亮了呢。
s_py: fáng jiān lǐ de dēng hái liàng le ne
zh: 房间里的灯还亮着呢。
py: fáng jiān lǐ de dēng hái liàng zhe ne
en: The light in the room is still on.
why: A light that is still on is a held state, so it needs 着 with 还 and 呢. 亮了 reports it coming on and cannot sit with 还 … 呢 here.

s: 已经十二月了，朋友的院子里还开着几朵花。
s_py: yǐ jīng shí èr yuè le péng yǒu de yuàn zi lǐ hái kāi zhe jǐ duǒ huā
zh: 已经十二月了，朋友的院子里还开着几朵花。
py: yǐ jīng shí èr yuè le péng yǒu de yuàn zi lǐ hái kāi zhe jǐ duǒ huā
en: It is already December, and a few flowers are still in bloom in my friend's yard.
why: Correct. 开着 describes flowers that are still open, and 几朵花 can follow it directly. 了 would only say they bloomed at some point.

zh: 朋友一直穿着那件红外套。
py: péng yǒu yì zhí chuān zhe nà jiàn hóng wài tào
en: My friend has been wearing that red coat all along.
why: 一直 goes before the verb, and 着 stays glued to 穿 with the object after it. 穿着 describes the coat as a lasting state.

src_py: tā dài shàng le yī tiáo lán wéi jīn
task: Say he is wearing the scarf now (a state).
zh: 他戴着一条蓝围巾。
py: tā dài zhe yī tiáo lán wéi jīn
en: He is wearing a blue scarf.
why: 戴上了 reports putting it on; 戴着 describes the state after that. 着 sits right after the verb and the object keeps its measure word.

q: 她___外套，你等一下，马上就好。
zh: 她在穿外套，你等一下，马上就好。
py: tā zài chuān wài tào nǐ děng yí xià mǎ shàng jiù hǎo
en: She is putting her coat on, wait a moment, she will be ready soon.
why: 等一下 and 马上就好 show the dressing is still happening, so 在穿. 穿着 describes a coat already on, and 穿过 only says she has worn it before.

q: 你看，今天特别冷，小李___一件厚外套。
zh: 你看，今天特别冷，小李穿着一件厚外套。
py: nǐ kàn jīn tiān tè bié lěng xiǎo lǐ chuān zhe yī jiàn hòu wài tào
en: Look, it is very cold today and Xiao Li is wearing a thick coat.
why: Here English is "is wearing", a state, so 穿着. 在穿 would mean he is in the middle of putting it on, and 穿过 only that he has worn one before.

q: 电梯门___，大家别着急往外走。
zh: 电梯门在开，大家别着急往外走。
py: diàn tī mén zài kāi dà jiā bié zháo jí wǎng wài zǒu
en: The lift door is opening, so don't rush out.
why: The cue is the door in motion, so 在开. 开着 would say it is already standing open, and 开过 that it has opened before.

q: 我朋友___打电话，你过一会儿再来吧。
zh: 我朋友在打电话，你过一会儿再来吧。
py: wǒ péng yǒu zài dǎ diàn huà nǐ guò yī huì r zài lái ba
en: My friend is on the phone, so come back in a little while.
why: 打电话 is an activity someone is busy doing, so 在 goes before the verb. 着 cannot mark a bare activity as in progress here, and 了 would report a finished call.

q: 朋友家的大门___，我们进不去。
zh: 朋友家的大门关着，我们进不去。
py: péng yǒu jiā de dà mén guān zhe wǒ men jìn bù qù
en: The gate of my friend's house is shut, so we can't get in.
why: The gate is simply in the shut state, so 关着. 在关 would need someone closing it right now, and 关过 only an earlier closing.

q: 客人快到了，妈妈___桌子，你去帮她拿几个盘子吧。
zh: 客人快到了，妈妈在摆桌子，你去帮她拿几个盘子吧。
py: kè rén kuài dào le mā mā zài bǎi zhuō zi nǐ qù bāng tā ná jǐ gè pán zi ba
en: The guests are almost here and Mum is laying the table; go and help her with some plates.
why: Mum is busy with the task and needs help, so the action in progress, 在摆. 摆着桌子 does not describe a state here, and 摆过 is experience.

q: 八点了，那家商店的灯还___，老板大概还没走。
zh: 八点了，那家商店的灯还亮着，老板大概还没走。
py: bā diǎn le nà jiā shāng diàn de dēng hái liàng zhe lǎo bǎn dà gài hái méi zǒu
en: It is eight o'clock and the shop's light is still on; the owner probably has not left.
why: A light that stays lit is a state, so 亮着 with 还. 亮了 reports it coming on, which clashes with 还, and 亮过 would only say it was on at some earlier time.

s: 窗户在开，所以屋里很冷。
s_py: chuāng hù zài kāi suǒ yǐ wū lǐ hěn lěng
zh: 窗户开着，所以屋里很冷。
py: chuāng hù kāi zhe suǒ yǐ wū lǐ hěn lěng
en: The window is open, so it is cold inside.
why: "Is open" is a state, so the window needs 开着. 在开 would mean it is in the middle of opening, which does not explain the cold.

s: 我去敲门的时候，他正在穿衣服，所以没听见。
s_py: wǒ qù qiāo mén de shí hòu tā zhèng zài chuān yī fu suǒ yǐ méi tīng jiàn
zh: 我去敲门的时候，他正在穿衣服，所以没听见。
py: wǒ qù qiāo mén de shí hòu tā zhèng zài chuān yī fu suǒ yǐ méi tīng jiàn
en: When I knocked he was getting dressed, so he did not hear.
why: Correct. 正在穿 is the act of dressing, which explains why he was busy and did not hear. 穿着 would only describe clothes he already had on.

zh: 小李在给朋友打电话。
py: xiǎo lǐ zài gěi péng yǒu dǎ diàn huà
en: Xiao Li is calling a friend.
why: 在 comes before the whole verb phrase 给朋友打电话 to show the call is in progress. It cannot be placed after 给朋友.

zh: 门口那个人穿着一件黑大衣。
py: mén kǒu nà ge rén chuān zhe yī jiàn hēi dà yī
en: The person at the door is wearing a black overcoat.
why: "Is wearing" is a state, so 穿着 follows the subject directly and the object keeps its number and measure word.

src_py: bà bà zài guān chuāng hù
task: Say the window is still closed (a state), starting with 窗户.
zh: 窗户还关着。
py: chuāng hù hái guān zhe
en: The window is still closed.
why: The state of being closed is 关着, while 在关 is the act of closing. 还 sits before the verb phrase.

q: 朋友们笑___说：“欢迎欢迎！”
zh: 朋友们笑着说：“欢迎欢迎！”
py: péng yǒu men xiào zhe shuō huān yíng huān yíng
en: My friends said with a smile, "Welcome, welcome!"
why: 笑 is the manner, so it takes 着 and the main verb 说 follows. 了 would make smiling a finished first step, and 地 is not used after a bare verb like 笑.

q: 我们坐___聊天，一点也不累。
zh: 我们坐着聊天，一点也不累。
py: wǒ men zuò zhe liáo tiān yì diǎn yě bù lèi
en: We chat sitting down and are not tired at all.
why: 坐 is the posture in which the chatting happens, so 着 goes on 坐. 在 would need a place after it, and 坐了聊天 does not join the two verbs.

q: 下雨天，我喜欢躺___听雨声。
zh: 下雨天，我喜欢躺着听雨声。
py: xià yǔ tiān wǒ xǐ huān tǎng zhe tīng yǔ shēng
en: On rainy days I like to listen to the rain lying down.
why: 躺 is the background posture of 听, so it takes 着. 躺在 needs a place such as 床上, and 躺了听 does not link the two verbs.

q: 弟弟哭___告诉我，朋友把他的玩具弄坏了。
zh: 弟弟哭着告诉我，朋友把他的玩具弄坏了。
py: dì di kū zhe gào sù wǒ péng yǒu bǎ tā de wán jù nòng huài le
en: My little brother told me, crying, that his friend had broken his toy.
why: 哭 describes how he told me, so it takes 着 and 告诉 is the main verb. 在 and 地 do not attach a bare verb to a following verb this way.

q: 我喜欢___音乐散步，一个人也不觉得无聊。
zh: 我喜欢听着音乐散步，一个人也不觉得无聊。
py: wǒ xǐ huān tīng zhe yīn yuè sàn bù yí gè rén yě bù jué dé wú liáo
en: I like to walk while listening to music, and I do not get bored on my own.
why: 听 is the background activity, so 听着 and 散步 is the main verb. 听了 would make listening a finished step before the walk, and 听过 is experience.

q: 别___手机跟朋友说话，这样不礼貌。
zh: 别看着手机跟朋友说话，这样不礼貌。
py: bié kàn zhe shǒu jī gēn péng yǒu shuō huà zhè yàng bù lǐ mào
en: Don't look at your phone while talking to a friend; it is rude.
why: The phone-watching is the accompanying action, marked by 着 on the first verb. 看了 and 看过 report a completed action or experience and cannot be forbidden this way.

q: 朋友们围___桌子坐下，一边吃一边聊起了暑假的计划。
zh: 朋友们围着桌子坐下，一边吃一边聊起了暑假的计划。
py: péng yǒu men wéi zhe zhuō zi zuò xià yī biān chī yī biān liáo qǐ le shǔ jià de jì huà
en: My friends sat down around the table and chatted about their summer plans while eating.
why: 围着桌子 is the manner or arrangement of sitting, so 着 goes on 围. 围了桌子坐下 does not join the verbs, and 围在 needs a place word.

q: 雨突然下大了，小王拉___我的手往前跑，一路上笑个不停。
zh: 雨突然下大了，小王拉着我的手往前跑，一路上笑个不停。
py: yǔ tū rán xià dà le xiǎo wáng lā zhe wǒ de shǒu wǎng qián pǎo yī lù shàng xiào gè bù tíng
en: The rain suddenly got heavy, and Xiao Wang ran ahead holding my hand, laughing all the way.
why: 拉 is how he ran, the background action, so it takes 着 and 跑 is the main verb. 拉在 needs a place and 拉过 is experience.

s: 小王躺看电视，一直没动。
s_py: xiǎo wáng tǎng kàn diàn shì yì zhí méi dòng
zh: 小王躺着看电视，一直没动。
py: xiǎo wáng tǎng zhe kàn diàn shì yì zhí méi dòng
en: Xiao Wang lay watching TV and never moved.
why: 躺 is the posture of watching, so it needs 着 to join the verbs. Two bare verbs in a row do not work here.

s: 弟弟站说着话，一点儿也不害羞。
s_py: dì di zhàn shuō zhe huà yì diǎn r yě bù hài xiū
zh: 弟弟站着说话，一点儿也不害羞。
py: dì di zhàn zhe shuō huà yì diǎn r yě bù hài xiū
en: My little brother stands up and talks without being shy at all.
why: 着 marks the background posture, so it sits on 站, not on the main verb 说. 站说着话 swaps the roles.

s: 我们笑着聊了一个下午，谁也没注意到外面下起了大雨。
s_py: wǒ men xiào zhe liáo le yí gè xià wǔ shuí yě méi zhù yì dào wài miàn xià qǐ le dà yǔ
zh: 我们笑着聊了一个下午，谁也没注意到外面下起了大雨。
py: wǒ men xiào zhe liáo le yí gè xià wǔ shuí yě méi zhù yì dào wài miàn xià qǐ le dà yǔ
en: We chatted away with smiles all afternoon and nobody noticed the heavy rain that had started outside.
why: Correct. 笑着 is the manner and 了 belongs to the main verb 聊, with the duration after it. The 着 stays on the first verb.

zh: 小王笑着说他明天有空。
py: xiǎo wáng xiào zhe shuō tā míng tiān yǒu kòng
en: Xiao Wang said with a smile that he is free tomorrow.
why: 笑着 is the manner and goes before the main verb 说; what he said follows.

zh: 我们坐着喝茶，聊了一个下午。
py: wǒ men zuò zhe hē chá liáo le yí gè xià wǔ
en: We sat drinking tea and chatted for a whole afternoon.
why: 坐着 is the background posture and comes before the verb 喝茶. 了 belongs to 聊, followed by the duration.

src: 他一边听音乐，一边跑步。
src_py: tā yī biān tīng yīn yuè yī biān pǎo bù
task: Rewrite with 着, making listening the background.
zh: 他听着音乐跑步。
py: tā tīng zhe yīn yuè pǎo bù
en: He runs while listening to music.
why: 着 goes on the background verb 听, and the main verb 跑步 follows. 着 sits before the object 音乐.

src: 小明一边淋雨，一边走回家。
src_py: xiǎo míng yī biān lín yǔ yī biān zǒu huí jiā
task: Rewrite with 着 on the background verb.
zh: 小明淋着雨走回家。
py: xiǎo míng lín zhe yǔ zǒu huí jiā
en: Xiao Ming walked home in the rain.
why: 淋 is the circumstance of the walk, so it takes 着 before its object 雨, and the main verb phrase 走回家 follows.

q: 桌子上放___两杯热茶。
zh: 桌子上放着两杯热茶。
py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe liǎng bēi rè chá
en: There are two cups of hot tea on the table.
why: Place + verb + 着 + number-measure-noun describes what is sitting there. 放在 needs a thing before it and a place after it, and 放过 is experience.

q: 墙上___一张世界地图。
zh: 墙上挂着一张世界地图。
py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng shì jiè dì tú
en: There is a world map hanging on the wall.
why: The place comes first and the new thing follows 挂着. 在挂 would need someone hanging it right now, and 挂在 would need the map first and a place after it.

q: 窗外的雪地上___着一串长长的脚印。
zh: 窗外的雪地上留着一串长长的脚印。
py: chuāng wài de xuě dì shàng liú zhe yī chuàn cháng cháng de jiǎo yìn
en: A long line of footprints is left on the snow outside the window.
why: Place + verb + 着 + thing needs a real verb before 着, and 留 (leave behind) fits. 在 and 到 are not verbs that can take 着 here.

q: 咖啡馆门口___一辆红色的自行车，是朋友的。
zh: 咖啡馆门口停着一辆红色的自行车，是朋友的。
py: kā fēi guǎn mén kǒu tíng zhe yī liàng hóng sè de zì xíng chē shì péng yǒu de
en: A red bicycle is parked at the cafe door; it belongs to my friend.
why: Place + 停着 + 一辆 + noun describes what is parked there. 停在 needs the bicycle first, and 在停 would need someone parking it right now.

q: 沙发上___一个人，是我的好朋友。
zh: 沙发上躺着一个人，是我的好朋友。
py: shā fā shàng tǎng zhe yí gè rén shì wǒ de hǎo péng yǒu
en: There is someone lying on the sofa; it is my good friend.
why: The place opens the sentence and the new person follows 躺着. 躺在 would put a place after the verb, and 在躺 is not used for a person introduced as new.

q: 黑板上___明天郊游的时间和地点，大家别忘了。
zh: 黑板上写着明天郊游的时间和地点，大家别忘了。
py: hēi bǎn shàng xiě zhe míng tiān jiāo yóu de shí jiān hé dì diǎn dà jiā bié wàng le
en: The time and place of tomorrow's outing are written on the board; don't forget.
why: Place + 写着 + thing says what is written there. 写在 needs the thing first, and 写过 would say it was written at some earlier time.

q: 窗台上___三盆花，春天一到，它们就开了。
zh: 窗台上摆着三盆花，春天一到，它们就开了。
py: chuāng tái shàng bǎi zhe sān pén huā chūn tiān yī dào tā men jiù kāi le
en: There are three pots of flowers on the windowsill; when spring comes they bloom.
why: Place + 摆着 + number + measure + noun describes what sits there. 摆在 needs the pots before it, and 在摆 needs a person doing it now.

s: 两把椅子放着桌子旁边。
s_py: liǎng bǎ yǐ zi fàng zhe zhuō zi páng biān
zh: 桌子旁边放着两把椅子。
py: zhuō zi páng biān fàng zhe liǎng bǎ yǐ zi
en: There are two chairs next to the table.
why: The place must come first, then 放着, then the thing. 着 cannot be followed directly by a place word.

s: 门口站着三个人，他们都是我的朋友。
s_py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe sān gè rén tā men dōu shì wǒ de péng yǒu
zh: 门口站着三个人，他们都是我的朋友。
py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe sān gè rén tā men dōu shì wǒ de péng yǒu
en: Three people are standing at the door; they are all my friends.
why: Correct. The place opens the sentence and the new people come after 站着 with a number and measure word.

zh: 墙上挂着一张画。
py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng huà
en: There is a painting hanging on the wall.
why: Place first, then 挂着, then 一张 and the thing. No 在 goes before the verb.

zh: 河边坐着几个钓鱼的人。
py: hé biān zuò zhe jǐ gè diào yú de rén
en: A few people are sitting by the river fishing.
why: Place first, then 坐着, then number and noun. The people are new information, so they come last.

zh: 冬天的公园里站着一个大雪人。
py: dōng tiān de gōng yuán lǐ zhàn zhe yí gè dà xuě rén
en: In the park in winter there stands a big snowman.
why: The place phrase comes first, then 站着 and the new thing with 一个. A thing standing somewhere takes this pattern.

src_py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī wǎn rè tāng
task: Rewrite with 放着 to show how it sits there.
zh: 桌子上放着一碗热汤。
py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī wǎn rè tāng
en: There is a bowl of hot soup on the table.
why: Replacing 有 with 放着 adds how the bowl sits there. The place stays first and the new thing follows with number and measure word.

q: 你___这把伞，我去买点东西。
zh: 你拿着这把伞，我去买点东西。
py: nǐ ná zhe zhè bǎ sǎn wǒ qù mǎi diǎn dōng xī
en: Hold this umbrella, I am going to buy a few things.
why: Hold-and-keep is 拿着, a command to stay in that state. 拿了 reports a completed taking and 在拿 describes what someone is doing right now.

q: 我去买票，你在这儿等___。
zh: 我去买票，你在这儿等着。
py: wǒ qù mǎi piào nǐ zài zhè r děng zhe
en: I'll go and buy the tickets; you wait here.
why: A command to keep waiting takes 着. 了 and 过 report something already done or experienced, which cannot be an order.

q: 你听___，下个月我们要去海边玩，先别告诉别人。
zh: 你听着，下个月我们要去海边玩，先别告诉别人。
py: nǐ tīng zhe xià gè yuè wǒ men yào qù hǎi biān wán xiān bié gào sù bié rén
en: Listen, we are going to the seaside next month; don't tell anyone yet.
why: An attention-getting command takes 着: keep listening. 了 and 过 report something already done and cannot open a command.

q: 你坐___吧，别站起来，我自己去拿。
zh: 你坐着吧，别站起来，我自己去拿。
py: nǐ zuò zhe ba bié zhàn qǐ lái wǒ zì jǐ qù ná
en: Stay seated, don't get up; I'll fetch it myself.
why: The point is to stay in the sitting state, so 坐着. 坐了 and 坐过 report something done and cannot be an order not to get up.

q: 这是我家的地址，你记___，下雪天路不好走。
zh: 这是我家的地址，你记着，下雪天路不好走。
py: zhè shì wǒ jiā de dì zhǐ nǐ jì zhe xià xuě tiān lù bù hǎo zǒu
en: This is my address, keep it in mind; the roads are bad on snowy days.
why: 记着 means keep it in mind, a command to maintain a state. 记了 and 记过 report a past action and cannot be an order.

q: 外面在下雨，你把我的雨衣带___，回家的时候用。
zh: 外面在下雨，你把我的雨衣带着，回家的时候用。
py: wài miàn zài xià yǔ nǐ bǎ wǒ de yǔ yī dài zhe huí jiā de shí hòu yòng
en: It is raining outside; take my raincoat along and use it on your way home.
why: 带着 is a command to keep it with you. 带了 reports a finished action, and 到 is not a particle that can follow 带 here.

q: 天气预报说晚上会降温，你把这件外套穿___，别着凉。
zh: 天气预报说晚上会降温，你把这件外套穿着，别着凉。
py: tiān qì yù bào shuō wǎn shàng huì jiàng wēn nǐ bǎ zhè jiàn wài tào chuān zhe bié zháo liáng
en: The forecast says it will get cold tonight; keep this coat on so you don't catch a cold.
why: The command is to keep the coat on, so 穿着. 穿了 and 穿过 report something done and cannot be an order to keep a state.

s: 你听了，这件事很重要。
s_py: nǐ tīng le zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòng yào
zh: 你听着，这件事很重要。
py: nǐ tīng zhe zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòng yào
en: Listen, this matter is important.
why: A command to listen takes 着. 了 turns it into a report of something already done and cannot open this kind of warning.

s: 你先别站起来，坐着吧，朋友们自己会找位子的。
s_py: nǐ xiān bié zhàn qǐ lái zuò zhe ba péng yǒu men zì jǐ huì zhǎo wèi zi de
zh: 你先别站起来，坐着吧，朋友们自己会找位子的。
py: nǐ xiān bié zhàn qǐ lái zuò zhe ba péng yǒu men zì jǐ huì zhǎo wèi zi de
en: Don't get up, just stay seated; my friends will find seats on their own.
why: Correct. 坐着吧 tells someone already sitting to stay that way, and 别站起来 supports it. 坐吧 would invite someone to sit down.

zh: 你先坐着吧。
py: nǐ xiān zuò zhe ba
en: Just stay seated for now.
why: 先 goes before the verb, and 坐着 with 吧 softens the order to keep the posture.

zh: 你在这儿等着我。
py: nǐ zài zhè r děng zhe wǒ
en: Wait here for me.
why: The place phrase 在这儿 comes before the verb, and 等着 keeps the waiting state going with 我 as the object.

src: 我去开门，你拿一下这把伞。
src_py: wǒ qù kāi mén nǐ ná yī xià zhè bǎ sǎn
zh: 我去开门，你拿着这把伞。
py: wǒ qù kāi mén nǐ ná zhe zhè bǎ sǎn
en: I'll go and open the door; you hold this umbrella.
why: 拿着 asks the person to keep holding it while I do something else. 拿一下 would only ask for a quick act.

q: 门___锁着，你一推就开了。
zh: 门没锁着，你一推就开了。
py: mén méi suǒ zhe nǐ yī tuī jiù kāi le
en: The door is not locked; just push and it opens.
why: The state 锁着 is denied with 没, never 不. 别 gives a command and does not describe the door.

q: 他今天___戴着帽子，脸都晒红了。
zh: 他今天没戴着帽子，脸都晒红了。
py: tā jīn tiān méi dài zhe mào zi liǎn dōu shài hóng le
en: He was not wearing a hat today, and his face got sunburnt.
why: A 着 state that is not the case in the past is denied with 没. 不 + verb + 着 is not used, and 别 is for commands.

q: 天太冷了，别站___，快进来坐吧。
zh: 天太冷了，别站着，快进来坐吧。
py: tiān tài lěng le bié zhàn zhe kuài jìn lái zuò ba
en: It is freezing; don't just stand there, come in and sit down.
why: 别 + verb + 着 says do not stay in that posture. 别站过 and 别站在 do not give this meaning.

q: 别躺___看手机，对眼睛不好。
zh: 别躺着看手机，对眼睛不好。
py: bié tǎng zhe kàn shǒu jī duì yǎn jīng bù hǎo
en: Don't look at your phone lying down; it is bad for your eyes.
why: 别 + 躺着 forbids the posture while doing the main verb. 躺了 and 躺过 do not join with 看手机.

q: 外面下雪了，你别开___窗户睡觉，会感冒的。
zh: 外面下雪了，你别开着窗户睡觉，会感冒的。
py: wài miàn xià xuě le nǐ bié kāi zhe chuāng hù shuì jiào huì gǎn mào de
en: It is snowing outside, so don't sleep with the window open; you will catch a cold.
why: 别开着窗户睡觉 means do not leave it open while sleeping. 开过 is experience, and 开在 needs a place after it.

q: 门口没放___鞋，说明他不在家。
zh: 门口没放着鞋，说明他不在家。
py: mén kǒu méi fàng zhe xié shuō míng tā bù zài jiā
en: There are no shoes left by the door, which shows he is not home.
why: Denying a 着 state uses 没: 没放着鞋 means no shoes are sitting there. 没放了 mixes the negator with 了, and 没放在 would need a place after it.

s: 刚才教室的门不锁着，我直接进去了。
s_py: gāng cái jiào shì de mén bù suǒ zhe wǒ zhí jiē jìn qù le
zh: 刚才教室的门没锁着，我直接进去了。
py: gāng cái jiào shì de mén méi suǒ zhe wǒ zhí jiē jìn qù le
en: The classroom door was not locked just now, so I went straight in.
why: A 着 state is denied with 没, not 不. 刚才 makes it a plain past denial, and 不锁着 is not a form Chinese uses here.

s: 窗户没开着，是我的朋友刚才关上的。
s_py: chuāng hù méi kāi zhe shì wǒ de péng yǒu gāng cái guān shàng de
zh: 窗户没开着，是我的朋友刚才关上的。
py: chuāng hù méi kāi zhe shì wǒ de péng yǒu gāng cái guān shàng de
en: The window is not open; my friend closed it just now.
why: Correct. 没开着 denies the state, and 关上的 adds that it was closed. The negator for a 着 state is 没.

s: 别站着聊了，我们找个地方坐下来吧。
s_py: bié zhàn zhe liáo le wǒ men zhǎo gè dì fāng zuò xià lái ba
zh: 别站着聊了，我们找个地方坐下来吧。
py: bié zhàn zhe liáo le wǒ men zhǎo gè dì fāng zuò xià lái ba
en: Let's stop standing around chatting and find somewhere to sit.
why: Correct. 别站着聊了 tells people to stop talking in the standing posture. 着 stays on the posture verb 站.

zh: 别躺着看手机。
py: bié tǎng zhe kàn shǒu jī
en: Don't look at your phone lying down.
why: 别 comes first and 着 stays on the posture verb 躺 before the main verb 看.

zh: 窗户没开着，是关着的。
py: chuāng hù méi kāi zhe shì guān zhe de
en: The window is not open; it is closed.
why: 没 denies the state 开着, and 是关着的 states what it is instead. 不开着 would be wrong.

task: Tell him not to, with 别.
zh: 别躺着看书。
py: bié tǎng zhe kàn shū
en: Don't read lying down.
why: 别 goes before the posture verb with 着 kept, forbidding that way of doing the main action.

task: Deny it with 没: the window is not open.
zh: 窗户没开着。
py: chuāng hù méi kāi zhe
en: The window is not open.
why: A 着 state is denied with 没, never 不.

q: 朋友们喝___茶聊天。
zh: 朋友们喝着茶聊天。
py: péng yǒu men hē zhe chá liáo tiān
en: My friends chat over tea.
why: 着 goes right after the verb 喝 and before its object 茶. 喝在茶 and 喝过茶 do not mean drinking while chatting.

q: 他唱___歌走进了教室。
zh: 他唱着歌走进了教室。
py: tā chàng zhe gē zǒu jìn le jiào shì
en: He walked into the classroom singing.
why: 着 attaches to 唱, before the object 歌, and 走进 is the main verb. 唱在歌 is not a phrase, and 唱过歌 is experience.

q: 他躺___床上看雨，一动也不想动。
zh: 他躺在床上看雨，一动也不想动。
py: tā tǎng zài chuáng shàng kàn yǔ yī dòng yě bù xiǎng dòng
en: He lies on the bed watching the rain and doesn't want to move at all.
why: 躺在床上 is verb + 在 + place with no 着. 躺着床上 puts 着 before a place, which is wrong, and 躺上床上 repeats the place word.

q: 奶奶坐___椅子上晒太阳，一坐就是一下午。
zh: 奶奶坐在椅子上晒太阳，一坐就是一下午。
py: nǎi nai zuò zài yǐ zi shàng shài tài yáng yī zuò jiù shì yī xià wǔ
en: Grandma sits on a chair in the sun and stays there the whole afternoon.
why: 坐在椅子上 is verb + 在 + place, with no 着. 坐着椅子上 is wrong, and 坐过 is experience.

s: 我们喝茶着聊天。
s_py: wǒ men hē chá zhe liáo tiān
zh: 我们喝着茶聊天。
py: wǒ men hē zhe chá liáo tiān
en: We chat over tea.
why: 着 attaches to the verb 喝 and goes before the object 茶. 喝茶着 puts it after the object.

s: 他躺在沙发上看书，一整个下午都没动。
s_py: tā tǎng zài shā fā shàng kàn shū yī zhěng gè xià wǔ dōu méi dòng
zh: 他躺在沙发上看书，一整个下午都没动。
py: tā tǎng zài shā fā shàng kàn shū yī zhěng gè xià wǔ dōu méi dòng
en: He lay on the sofa reading and did not move all afternoon.
why: Correct. With 躺在 + place the verb takes no 着. Adding 着 would be wrong, which makes this look like a trap.

s: 他蹲着在门口等朋友。
s_py: tā dūn zhe zài mén kǒu děng péng yǒu
zh: 他蹲在门口等朋友。
py: tā dūn zài mén kǒu děng péng yǒu
en: He squats at the door waiting for a friend.
why: Verb + 在 + place takes no 着. 蹲着在 puts 着 in front of the 在 phrase, which Chinese never does.

zh: 她坐在窗边看雨。
py: tā zuò zài chuāng biān kàn yǔ
en: She sits by the window watching the rain.
why: 坐在 + place has no 着, and the main verb 看雨 follows the place.

zh: 我们在咖啡馆里坐着聊天。
py: wǒ men zài kā fēi guǎn lǐ zuò zhe liáo tiān
en: We sit in the cafe chatting.
why: The place phrase goes before 坐着, and 着 stays on the verb. 坐着在咖啡馆里 is wrong. The place may also open the sentence.

src_py: tā zài shā fā shàng tǎng zhe
task: Say it with 躺在 (no 着).
zh: 他躺在沙发上。
py: tā tǎng zài shā fā shàng
en: He is lying on the sofa.
why: 躺在 + place needs no 着. The place moves behind the verb.

q: 我知道___他的名字，可是不知道他的电话。
zh: 我知道他的名字，可是不知道他的电话。
py: wǒ zhī dào tā de míng zi kě shì bù zhī dào tā de diàn huà
en: I know his name, but I do not know his phone number.
why: 知道 is a state of knowing with nothing to hold, so it never takes 着, even though English "know" feels ongoing.

q: 朋友昨天到___上海，今天已经去玩了。
zh: 朋友昨天到了上海，今天已经去玩了。
py: péng yǒu zuó tiān dào le shàng hǎi jīn tiān yǐ jīng qù wán le
en: My friend arrived in Shanghai yesterday and has already gone out today.
why: 到 is an instant change that finished yesterday, so 到了. 着 cannot attach to an instant verb, and 过 would mean has been there at some time.

q: 我们在车站等___两个小时，朋友才到。
zh: 我们在车站等了两个小时，朋友才到。
py: wǒ men zài chē zhàn děng le liǎng gè xiǎo shí péng yǒu cái dào
en: We waited at the station for two hours before our friend arrived.
why: A duration follows the verb, and 着 cannot be measured, so 等了两个小时. 过 would mean we once waited, which does not fit 才到.

q: 我看见___朋友站在门口，就走过去了。
zh: 我看见朋友站在门口，就走过去了。
py: wǒ kàn jiàn péng yǒu zhàn zài mén kǒu jiù zǒu guò qù le
en: I saw my friend standing at the door and went over.
why: 看见 already has a result complement (见), so it never takes 着. 站在门口 is verb + 在 + place and has no 着 either.

q: 雨下___一晚上，早上才停。
zh: 雨下了一晚上，早上才停。
py: yǔ xià le yī wǎn shàng zǎo shàng cái tíng
en: It rained all night and only stopped in the morning.
why: A duration (一晚上) follows the verb, so 了 not 着. 在 cannot follow 下 here.

q: 他去年大学毕业___，现在在一家公司工作。
zh: 他去年大学毕业了，现在在一家公司工作。
py: tā qù nián dà xué bì yè le xiàn zài zài yī jiā gōng sī gōng zuò
en: He graduated from university last year and now works in a company.
why: 毕业 is an instant change, so it takes 了 for completion. 着 cannot attach to it, and 过 would be an odd experience reading.

q: 天黑以前，我们终于走到___朋友住的村子。
zh: 天黑以前，我们终于走到了朋友住的村子。
py: tiān hēi yǐ qián wǒ men zhōng yú zǒu dào le péng yǒu zhù de cūn zi
en: Before dark we finally reached the village where my friend lives.
why: 走到 marks arrival with an instant end point, so 了. 着 cannot follow it, and 过 would contradict 终于.

q: 我觉得___今年夏天会比去年热，大家都要多喝水。
zh: 我觉得今年夏天会比去年热，大家都要多喝水。
py: wǒ jué de jīn nián xià tiān huì bǐ qù nián rè dà jiā dōu yào duō hē shuǐ
en: I think this summer will be hotter than last year, so everyone should drink more water.
why: 觉得 is a thinking verb with nothing to hold, so it never takes 着.

q: 冬天到___，大家都穿上了厚衣服。
zh: 冬天到了，大家都穿上了厚衣服。
py: dōng tiān dào le dà jiā dōu chuān shàng le hòu yī fú
en: Winter has come, and everyone has put on thick clothes.
why: 到 is an instant change, so it takes 了 and never 着. 过 would mean winter had come at some earlier time, which does not fit.

s: 他到着公园，朋友还没来。
s_py: tā dào zhe gōng yuán péng yǒu hái méi lái
zh: 他到了公园，朋友还没来。
py: tā dào le gōng yuán péng yǒu hái méi lái
en: He has arrived at the park; his friend has not come yet.
why: 到 is an instant verb and never takes 着. 了 reports the arrival.

s: 我们在雨里等了半个小时，朋友才来。
s_py: wǒ men zài yǔ lǐ děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí péng yǒu cái lái
zh: 我们在雨里等了半个小时，朋友才来。
py: wǒ men zài yǔ lǐ děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí péng yǒu cái lái
en: We waited in the rain for half an hour before our friend came.
why: Correct. A duration follows 等, so it takes 了. 等着半个小时 would be wrong.

s: 我昨天就听懂着他的话，所以不用翻译。
s_py: wǒ zuó tiān jiù tīng dǒng zhe tā de huà suǒ yǐ bù yòng fān yì
zh: 我昨天就听懂了他的话，所以不用翻译。
py: wǒ zuó tiān jiù tīng dǒng le tā de huà suǒ yǐ bù yòng fān yì
en: I already understood his words yesterday, so no translation was needed.
why: 听懂 already carries a result complement, so it never takes 着. The completed result takes 了.

zh: 我认识小王三年了。
py: wǒ rèn shí xiǎo wáng sān nián le
en: I have known Xiao Wang for three years.
why: 认识 is a state and never takes 着. The duration 三年 follows the object and 了 ends the sentence.

src: 他在门口站着，站了半个小时。
src_py: tā zài mén kǒu zhàn zhe zhàn le bàn gè xiǎo shí
task: Combine into one sentence: he stood at the door for half an hour.
zh: 他在门口站了半个小时。
py: tā zài mén kǒu zhàn le bàn gè xiǎo shí
en: He stood at the door for half an hour.
why: A duration follows the verb, so 了, not 着. 着 states a position but cannot be measured.
